acts.detail: served count of completed habits (value_moments) — number of completions per category for asked time on [proxy]; correction 0 of 2

args.query:
SELECT h.category, COUNT(*) AS completions
FROM fct_value_moments v
JOIN dim_habit h ON v.habit_id = h.habit_id
JOIN dim_users u ON v.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.is_internal = FALSE
AND v.completed_date BETWEEN DATE('2025-09-01') AND DATE('2026-07-12')
GROUP BY h.category
ORDER BY completions DESC;
